title: Improving JEV Entailment Reranking with Span Readouts and Selective Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2610.35654v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: JEV decision models pair a language model backbone with a lightweight scoring head to select among natural-language options. Direct selection compares candidate answers within one request, whereas entailment reranking evaluates each candidate in a separate natural language inference (NLI) request over fixed relation options. We examine whether the readout and adaptation choices used for direct selection remain effective for cross-request reranking. We combine a mean-span readout with selective backbone adaptation. Mean-span pooling replaces the option-ending pointer with an average of the contextualized states inside each NLI option, without adding head parameters. Selective adaptation retains low-rank updates in attention and gated DeltaNet projections while removing feed-forward adapters. translated_title: 使用跨度读取与选择性适配改进JEV蕴含重排序
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.35654v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：JEV决策模型将语言模型骨干网络与轻量级评分头相结合，以在自然语言选项中进行选择。直接选择方式在单个请求内比较候选答案，而蕴含重排序则通过独立的自然语言推理（NLI）请求，基于固定的关系选项对每个候选进行评估。我们研究了用于直接选择的读取和适配方法在跨请求重排序场景中是否依然有效。我们将平均跨度读取与选择性骨干适配相结合：平均跨度池化用每个NLI选项内上下文状态的平均值取代原有的选项结尾指针，且不增加评分头的参数；选择性适配则在注意力和门控DeltaNet投影中保留低秩更新，同时移除前馈适配器。在MC11基准（对来自七个来源的十一种重排序配置取平均准确率）上，选择性适配提升了NeoHorse-1-4B的准确率……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出结合平均跨度读取与选择性骨干适配的方法，用NLI选项内上下文状态均值替代选项结尾指针，并在保留注意力与门控DeltaNet投影低秩更新的同时移除前馈适配器，从而有效提升了JEV蕴含重排序在MC11基准上的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper improves JEV entailment reranking by combining mean-span readouts with selective backbone adaptation, replacing option-ending pointers with averaged contextualized states within each NLI option and retaining low-rank updates in attention and gated DeltaNet projections while removing feed-forward adapters, yielding accuracy gains on the MC11 benchmark.
